name: Delivery to Mathias
summary: Keryn Sylvius sends a sealed parcel from Goldshire to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. The delivery gives a promising rogue entry into SI:7's inner workings.

sections.title: A Courier's Test
sections.body: A parcel from the Lion's Pride Inn to the Stormwind Barracks may look like ordinary courier work. For a budding rogue, it is an audition for Stormwind Intelligence. Local trainer Keryn Sylvius entrusts the package to novice cutpurses, giving them a direct introduction to Master Mathias Shaw. The delivery tests whether they can cross the capital quietly, keep a low profile, and follow discreet orders without asking questions.

sections.title: Gateway to SI:7
sections.body: The handoff brings an operative into SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. Mathias Shaw uses such deliveries to separate pretenders from true talents. Those who present the parcel without faltering receive high-stakes field assignments, beginning with covert reconnaissance and infiltration against Defias smuggling networks in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What is inside the Delivery to Mathias?
faq.answer: The parcel stays sealed to its courier. It may hold intelligence reports, trainee assessments, or confidential material about local threats such as the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn.
Keryn Sylvius hands over the delivery. She is a rogue operative and trainer stationed upstairs at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: Where does Mathias Shaw keep his headquarters?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw keeps his headquarters on the second floor of the SI:7 building, in the southeastern corner of Old Town within the Stormwind Barracks compound.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the parcel to Shaw?
faq.answer: After Shaw confirms your capability, he initiates you into field espionage and sends you to infiltrate Jerod's Landing. There, you steal a shipping schedule from a Defias dockmaster.

angles.text: As a rogue, you carry a package that marks a passage from petty back-alley brawling into royal intelligence under Mathias Shaw.
As an Alliance operative, you carry covert dispatches between regional scouts and the capital, helping Stormwind's secretive espionage apparatus counter internal subversion.
